objective: Estimate the contribution of explicit role conditioning with a matched Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B backbone, dataset, optimizer, training-example order and training budget.

arms.role_on: Original V5 field title and role definition on query and candidate documents.
arms.role_off: Remove field title and role definition on both query and candidate documents; retain narrative, class label, parent label, official code, and field-admissible candidate inventory. Shared material-agent candidates become identical.

common_evidence: Crop each narrative once with the base tokenizer to 256 minus maximum V5 role-prefix token length minus 8. Both arms receive the exact same crop. Same 256-token model limit; verify role-on strings fit. This controls the extra narrative that could otherwise be exposed by removing prefixes.
data: Original fixed seed13 split: 40000 train, 5000 validation, 5000 test. Identical split source hash checked before use. No public upload of narratives or record-level outputs.
seed_scope: Single matched training seed. Do not report cross-seed standard deviations.

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch, not validation- or test-selected
training.order: Same deterministic seed13 record-field permutation in both arms; verify order hash and optimizer update count.
training.negative_mining: Each arm mines 20 highest-scoring non-gold candidates using its own alignment checkpoint and TRAIN ONLY; refinement takes first 4, same inventory and policy. The refinement comparison estimates total pipeline effect, including arm-specific mining.

evaluation.primary: Role-on minus role-off test mean field Top1 after refinement
secondary: mean Top1 on three material-agent fields
evaluation.ranking: Cosine similarity over identical field-admissible candidate identities. Stable taxonomy-order tie break.
evaluation.uncertainty: 10000 paired record bootstrap replicates, seed20261021, all eight fields and two arms kept together; conditional on fixed single-seed models. Exploratory secondary intervals without multiplicity adjustment.
evaluation.prohibition: No tuning, checkpoint selection, seed selection, or training-order changes based on test performance. Frozen-test access allowed only after this protocol and implementation hashes are frozen.

execution_order: Finish both matched alignment arms before either refinement so budget exhaustion preserves a matched comparison.
limits: New matched retraining; common-evidence cropping, cached MNRL and controlled RNG differ from historical paper exports. Cannot reuse historical ESAW-Link scores as this experiment's role-on control. Does not compare backbones or separate query-side from document-side role effects. Role-off shared-inventory fields necessarily receive identical candidate rankings, a structural consequence of removing all role information. Budget-matched alignment uses1epoch rather than historical3; this ablation estimates the role effect under the declared shorter schedule, not the exact historical61.75% run.
budget_reason: Compute budget constraints: both arms use one alignment epoch and one refinement epoch. Cloud account, billing and instance metadata omitted.
